north_star.name: reviewed_building_opportunities
north_star.definition: Organizations that complete a guided model review and confirm a scoped multi-floor or recurring conversion need.

privacy_rules: Do not send drawing names, project names, source hashes, model hashes, emails, or artifact URLs to analytics.
Keep optional analytics off until the user consents.
Publication consent and training-data contact consent are separate from service acceptance.

decision_thresholds.then: Revise offer and audience language before adding traffic.
Narrow channels and add stronger professional-use qualification.
Fix scheduling and review handoff before accepting more pilots.
Reassess value proposition and target segment before paid media.
Pause new acceptance until capacity returns.
